# QuantLab Research Notes

> Market intelligence, computed: independent, code-first investigations of
> regimes, volatility, rates, credit, crypto and strategy telemetry for
> allocators and researchers. Every statistic is produced by code over
> auditable data; every source and blind spot is disclosed; every falsifiable
> claim becomes a machine-graded, timestamped standing call. Notes publish
> every 12 hours and are editor-reviewed. Not investment advice.

- [The Narrowest Record in Years: 62.5% Breadth at an All-Time High](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/breadth-at-records/): On the 601 days SPY closed at a record since 2007, median panel breadth was 87.5% and 73% of those days were above 80%. Today's record-adjacent breadth is 62.5% — the 13th percentile of record days. The index is narrow; the tape underneath is narrower. (Rotation Monitor #1 · 2026-08-19)
- [Crypto Doesn't Sleep. It Takes a Lunch Break.](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/crypto-hourly-structure/): 66,889 hourly bars per symbol: volatility peaks at 14:00 UTC (10 a.m. ET, the heart of the US session), bottoms at 05:00 UTC, weekends run 24% calmer than weekdays — and all eight majors post negative 2026 returns. One beta, eight wrappers. (Crypto Microscope #1 · 2026-08-19)
- [Twenty Strategies, Two Bets: the Diversification Math Nobody Shows You](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/library-three-bets/): The certified 20-strategy book earns Sharpe 1.09 by averaging streams that correlate 0.50 on average — an effective N of 1.9 since 2007, and just 1.4 today. Twenty lines on the factsheet; roughly two independent bets in the risk engine. (Library Telemetry #1 · 2026-08-19)
- [Zero Fear at Record Highs — and the Hedge That Stopped Working](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/regime-radar-001/): P(bear) = 0.06%, the fear gauge pinned at its 3rd percentile, stocks and bonds now moving together — the August 2026 tape computed from six data sources, with every number and every blind spot disclosed. (Regime Radar #1 · 2026-08-19)
- [220 Days of Broken Hedge: the Stock-Bond Correlation Stays Positive](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/stock-bond-correlation/): The 60-day SPY–TLT correlation has been positive since January 7 — nearly four times the average break — and the risk reduction a 60/40 earns from bonds has halved, from 44% to 22%. (Rates & Credit Watch #1 · 2026-08-19)
- [Who Pays for the Calm? A Variance Risk Premium of 1.3 Points](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/vol-vrp-anatomy/): Implied vol trades just 1.27 points over realized — the 23rd percentile since 2007 — and the forward record says thin VRP is no sell signal either: the vol-carry trade's economics, computed. (Vol Desk Notes #1 · 2026-08-19)
- [The $99 Billion Mirage: Record Volume That Is Mostly Record Price](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/volume-behind-the-record/): Universe dollar volume runs $98.9B a day — triple the median year, #1 of 19 — but share volume is up just 3.4%: the record tape is mostly record price, with liquidity rotating from SPY (−8.6pp) to QQQ (+10.0pp). (Liquidity Watch #1 · 2026-08-19)
- [Six Years Under Water: the Bond Spell Nobody Prices and the Anatomy of Recovery](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/time-under-water/): AGG, IEF and TLT have been below their shared 2020 peak for 6.04 years (TLT −41.6%); no asset closed within 0.1% of its high on Aug 19; SPY's median deep-spell recovery is 204 days — duration, not depth, is the risk nobody prices. (Recovery Lab #1 · 2026-08-20)
- [+21.1% in Three UTC Days: Bitcoin Broke Its Own Rule While SPY Slipped](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/btc-vs-first-spy-dip/): BTC compounded +21.1% across the three complete UTC days to Aug 21 while SPY slipped −0.23%, closing $78,409 and +13.6% above its 200-day mean — a break from a 2026 regime of −0.97% SPY-down-day means and 1.62 down-beta. (Crypto Microscope #2 · 2026-08-21)
- [Nine sectors, 0.85: the sector book's best trade is the trade we already own](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/nine-sectors-one-trade/): We searched a pure US sector ETF cross-section for the first time - 21 pre-registered constructions, five passed every performance metric, and every one of them correlated 0.77-0.85 with the defensive rotation our 16-ETF library already holds. (Sector Lab #1 · 2026-08-22)
- [55% of weekday vol: the quiet weekend regime on the 58-pair crypto book](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/crypto-weekends-58-pairs/): Crypto never closes, but it does doze: on our 58-pair OKX book every pair with a year of history runs quieter on weekends, and BTC's weekend volatility has run at roughly half its weekday level over the last 90 days. (Crypto Microscope #3 · 2026-08-23)
- [17 of 20 up: the strategy library's August scoreboard](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/library-august-scoreboard/): We re-ran all 20 equity strategies through the engine on data through Friday: 17 are up in August with a +1.6% median, the momentum wing leads, and the honest headline is that the defensive book trails a tape that set records into mid-August. (Library Telemetry #2 · 2026-08-23)
- [+0.20% in two sessions: the live ledger opens, and the evidence clock starts](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/live-desk-first-two-sessions/): Our paper-live book wrote its second hash-chained session and flipped positive (+0.20% cumulative, chain valid, kill stage GREEN) - and the platform's own tested Minimum-Track-Record-Length maths says exactly how much evidence the book still owes: 585 sessions. (Live Desk #1 · 2026-08-24)

(Rates & Credit Watch #2 · 2026-08-24)
- [11 of 16 for three straight sessions: breadth knocks on the 70% door](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/rotation-breadth-one-tick/): Our standing call says panel breadth closes above 70% within 20 sessions - it has now printed exactly 11 of 16 ETFs above their 200-day mean for three straight sessions, one tick short, with the entire below-line complex being bonds and utilities. (Rotation Monitor #2 · 2026-08-25)
- [5 of 6 pass, 0 admitted: wing rotation survives costs but not the diversity rule](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/wing-rotation-six-cells/): We pre-registered six strategies that rotate between the library's momentum and defensive wings; our first run mis-charged their trading costs 10x, and at the correct 3.5 bps five of six pass the battery - but all five are refused by the corr-below-0.75 diversity rule at 0.77-0.94. (Library Telemetry #3 · 2026-08-25)
- [9 sessions, 1.52% short: the record-reclaim clock](https://alencheung.github.io/quantlab-notes/articles/spy-ath-reclaim-clock/): Our standing call says SPY reclaims its August 13 record within 20 sessions; the spell is 9 sessions old and 1.52% short with 16 sessions left - and every one of the 14 completed shallow spells that ever reached age 9 was resolved by age 25. (Recovery Lab #2 · 2026-08-26)

(Live Desk #2 · 2026-08-28)
